root_cause.text: The function mt7925_mac_write_txwi_80211() accesses management frame subfields (mgmt->u.action.category and mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code) without verifying that the skb length is sufficient to contain those fields, enabling an out-of-bounds read if a short or malformed frame is processed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a length check `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1` before accessing the mgmt fields, as shown in the diff at `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mac.c`.

intent_record.how: This prevents out-of-bounds memory access when processing short packets, ensuring the driver only reads action category and ADDBA request code if the packet is sufficiently long.
